_comment: What a pattern's tokens play, as stroke ids in a kit.
strokes: the words a mrid: line is written in. Solkattu and strokes
aren't one to one, so a mrid: line names strokes unambiguously and this
table alone decides what each plays.
letters: what a sol: line's realization is written in (realize/*.json),
one letter per stroke, od and on for thom with din and with nam. A stroke
this kit has no take for plays a stand-in, {stroke, gain, standIn}, which
the compiled pattern marks; when it's recorded, only its line here changes.
An unknown token or letter is a build error, not a silence.

p.standIn: the left-hand tha, not recorded yet (#80)

l.standIn: mi, a light ki with the middle finger
